instruction.name: xvreplgr2vr.w
instruction.description: Broadcast the low 32 bits of `val` to all lanes of `dst`.

latencies.notes: 2 cycles for this direction. The two directions cannot be separated by chaining, so the split follows the microarchitecture: an FPR or vector load cannot bypass, and the vector float reset helper measures pick + 2 + repl = 7 for LSX and 9 for LASX, which fixes the pick at 3 and 5. The stored experiment is the round trip.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvreplgr2vr.w $xr0, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr1, $r5; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr2, $r6; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr3, $r7; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr4, $r8; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr5, $r9; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr6, $r10; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr7, $r11
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --counter 0xfa --init 'li.d $r4, 1; li.d $r5, 2; li.d $r6, 3; li.d $r7, 4; li.d $r8, 5; li.d $r9, 6; li.d $r10, 7; li.d $r11, 8' --asm 'xvreplgr2vr.w $xr0, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr1, $r5; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr2, $r6; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr3, $r7; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr4, $r8; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr5, $r9; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr6, $r10; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr7, $r11'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 8.00 cycles. Counter 0xfa normalised per instruction.

notes: xvreplgr2vr.w latency is 1 cycle(s), measured as a round trip through xvpickve2gr.d.
